dropped.item: Closing engagement question/call to action: 'What's worked for you in reducing no-shows?'
Framing that the change was simple ('The change was simple')
'when they need it': the timeliness of care as a benefit

changed.item: 'sometimes the biggest operational wins come from...' became 'the biggest operational wins often come from...' (frequency/certainty strengthened)
Framed as a personal lesson learned ('The lesson for me') became a general opinion ('I think')
